The Festus Osifo Foundation, in collaboration with the Nigeria Scrabble Federation, will offer a $3,000 top prize at the maiden National Scrabble Classics scheduled to hold in Benin City, Edo State, from November 21 to 22. The two-day competition, which will take place at Cathelea Hotel, will feature four categories: Masters, Intermediate, Opens and Under-16. The Masters winner will receive $3,000, while the champions in the Intermediate and Opens categories will earn $2,000 and $1,000, respectively. The winner of the Under-16 category will go home with N500,000 and a laptop, with other incentives also available to participants. The tournament, themed ‘Fueled by Words, Driven by Excellence’, has secured ratings from the Nigeria Scrabble Federation, Pan African Scrabble Association and World English-Language Scrabble Players Association. Aka urges Tinubu to reward African Scrabble champions Okpebholo, Obaseki trade accusations over N8bn Tinubu hasn’t kept all 2023 promises, but economy has improved — Edo commissioner The recognition from the three bodies is expected to strengthen the competition’s standing and provide players with an opportunity to earn ratings through their performances. The organisers said the championship would bring together players from different categories to test their skills while promoting competitive Scrabble in the country. The inclusion of the Under-16 category is also expected to provide a platform for young players to develop their abilities and compete for significant rewards. The maiden edition is part of efforts by the foundation and the federation to support the growth of Scrabble and encourage emerging talents in Nigeria. Kindly share this story:
